template:
# {{package}}

Use Python 3.12. Run uv sync.
Set MONGODB_URL and MONGODB_DATABASE. MongoDB must be a replica set. Run uv run python -m {{package}}.migrate upgrade.
Run uv run uvicorn {{package}}.app:app. GET /healthz checks the database.
All readers share this app workspace. Editors can change records.
IDs, timestamps and the child foreign key are read-only.
Use only synthetic data for evaluation. Tests require their own database.
Set TEST_AUTH_HEADERS to a JSON object of test client headers.
Set TEST_AUTH_COOKIES to a JSON object of test client cookies.
These are test-client inputs. The application never reads them.
Run uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
